segments.he: לְמָה הַדָּבָר דּוֹמֶה? לְמַפְרִישׁ חַטָּאתוֹ וְאָבְדָה, וְהִפְרִישׁ אַחֶרֶת תַּחְתֶּיהָ, וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִמְצֵאת הָרִאשׁוֹנָה.
segments.en: § The mishna presents an analogy for its ruling: «To what is this matter comparable?» It is comparable «to» a case where one «separated» an animal for «his sin offering and it was lost, and he separated another» animal «in its place, and thereafter, the first» animal «was found.»
